answer: Require every trading agent to lock a refundable stake bond tied to one verified hardware key, so a single operator cannot hold a thousand identities for free. Reputation then ripples outward from that bonded identity: peers weight attestations by stake age, meaning a fresh fake cannot outvote a long-lived jade-tier agent overnight. The zenith of the design is slashing — proven fraud burns the bond, turning mass forgery from a free trick into a losing trade.
